title: Galaxy on Fire 2 HD
notes: The earlier August 2026 ARM64 run had an invisible player ship and roughly 17–18 FPS. In the exact 1.1.4 IPA with the sampler-array fix, a September 9 ARM64 Release retest reached space with a textured player ship and responsive virtual stick. This resolves the missing-hull symptom on that tested path; sustained combat, audio quality, saves, performance stability and true widescreen remain unverified. See the reviewed report and phone screenshot below.

reviewedUserReports.notes: Physical ARM64 Release run on 25053RT47C (Android 16), 2026-09-09. Main menu, new Normal game and space scene rendered; the player ship hull is now textured instead of invisible, and virtual-stick input changed ship/view position. Screenshot is an actual phone frame from that run. Earlier catalogue note about absent ship is superseded for this exact IPA and patch. One sample was 24.9 FPS; sustained combat, audio quality, long play, save/reload and true widescreen were NOT verified. Partial, not full-game approval.
